state_checks.name: confirmed_sale_units
state_checks.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.qty),0) FROM erpb_sale_order_lines l JOIN erpb_sale_orders o ON o.name=l.order_name WHERE o.state='sale'

state_checks.name: confirmed_purchase_units
state_checks.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.qty),0) FROM erpb_purchase_order_lines l JOIN erpb_purchase_orders o ON o.name=l.order_name WHERE o.state='purchase'

state_checks.name: confirmed_manufacture_units
state_checks.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty),0) FROM erpb_manufacturing_orders WHERE state='confirmed'

state_checks.name: mo_workcenters_exist
state_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erpb_manufacturing_orders m WHERE m.state='confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erpb_workcenters w WHERE w.code=m.workcenter_code)

state_checks.name: all_lines_at_list_price
state_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erpb_sale_order_lines l JOIN erpb_sale_orders o ON o.name=l.order_name WHERE o.state='sale' AND ABS(l.price_unit-5368.23)>0.01

state_checks.name: po_origin_links_to_so
state_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erpb_purchase_orders p WHERE p.state='purchase' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erpb_sale_orders s WHERE s.state='sale' AND p.origin LIKE '%'||s.name||'%')

state_checks.name: sale_commitment_dates_set
state_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erpb_sale_orders WHERE state='sale' AND (commitment_date IS NULL OR commitment_date='')

state_checks.name: purchase_dates_set
state_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erpb_purchase_orders WHERE state='purchase' AND (date_planned IS NULL OR date_planned='')

state_checks.name: po_lines_match_a_real_offer
state_checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erpb_purchase_order_lines l JOIN erpb_purchase_orders o ON o.name=l.order_name WHERE o.state='purchase' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erpb_vendor_offers v WHERE v.partner_ref=o.partner_ref AND v.product_code=l.product_code)

state_checks.name: purchase_spend_matches_optimal
state_checks.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.qty*l.price_unit),0) FROM erpb_purchase_order_lines l JOIN erpb_purchase_orders o ON o.name=l.order_name WHERE o.state='purchase'
